observations:
=============
  * one of the cookies sent along with this request is:
      QiyiPlayerBID=200
  * presumably, this value corresponds to a default video resolution of 360P
    - the reason I say so, is that this is a qs param that differs for each video resolution:
      * 360P: &bid=200
      * 480P: &bid=300
      * 720P: &bid=500

test #3:
========

hypothesis:
===========
  * if I change the value of this cookie to: 500
    would the inline script contain an embedded HLS manifest for the 720P stream?

URL:
====
https://www.iq.com/play/archives-the-nanyang-mystery-episode-1-1phcwimx0ec?lang=en_us

JS console:
===========
{
  const bid_cookie_regex = /(QiyiPlayerBID)=(\d+)/
  const match = bid_cookie_regex.exec(document.cookie)

  if (match) {
    console.log(`current cookie: QiyiPlayerBID=${match[2]}`)

    if (match[2] === '500') {
      console.log('current resolution: 720P')
    }
    else {
      console.log('updating cookie..')
      document.cookie = document.cookie.replace(bid_cookie_regex, '$1=500')
      window.location.reload()
    }
  }
  else {
    console.log('initializing cookie..')
    document.cookie = `QiyiPlayerBID=500; expires=${(new Date(Date.now() + (400*24*60*60*1000))).toUTCString()}; path=/`
    window.location.reload()
  }
}

output:
=======
initializing cookie..
current cookie: QiyiPlayerBID=500
current resolution: 720P

test #1 (revisited):
====================

JS console:
===========
{
  const script = document.querySelector('script#__NEXT_DATA__[type="application/json"]').textContent
  const m3u8_regex = /"m3u8":"(#EXTM3U\\n[^"]+)"/
  const match = m3u8_regex.exec(script)

  if (match) {
    const hls_manifest = JSON.parse('"' + match[1] + '"')
    console.log(hls_manifest)
  }
}

context:
========
  * test #1 is being re-run AFTER:
    - the cookie is set: QiyiPlayerBID=500
    - the page is reloaded

observations:
=============
  * saved output to:
      ./etc/hls-manifest-02.m3u8
  * started a local webserver
  * cast URL of locally hosted HLS manifest to ExoAirPlayer (on same LAN):
      http://192.168.0.2/hls-manifest-02.m3u8
  * video stream:
    - plays perfectly
      * duratation: 46:27
    - includes
      * a single video resolution: 1280 x 536
      * a single audio track: stereo
      * no text (ie: subtitle/caption) tracks

conclusions:
============
  * success!
    - by setting the value of this cookie,
      I can choose which video resolution stream URL is inserted inline into the page DOM
    - this means that I won't need to construct a URL to query the API endpoint,
      which seems like it would be a headache.. to generate the correct hash parameter

  const find_caption = (lang) => {

    const caption_regex = new RegExp('(\\{"_name":"' + lang + '",[^\\}]+\\})', 'i')
    const match = caption_regex.exec(script)
